title.narrative: V20 Tipping points for a just green transition

description.narrative: Climate Vulnerable Forum V20 is a collection of states vulnerable to climate change. They established a secretariat in 2023 – answering directly to the presidency (currently Barbados) and member nations.The secretariat of the CVF V20, as well as important member countries will present a report analyzing “super levers” which will include a list of potential tipping point interventions and compile a comprehensive list of potential interventions. The aim (outcome) is that the report can drive a significant step-change in the priorities of donors, V20 governments, development finance providers and private investors. The report will also provide an action plan for the next two years, with the aim to galvanize platforms around critical and feasible priorities.
